cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may join my plan for Denise's surprise leaving party. I need her out of the office at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I skip washing glasses this time?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exemption granted. I'll wash. You are being considered for the more distinguished coffee diversion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave until I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I authorize you to delegate it to me. Take her for coffee; you may complain about my work if she starts getting suspicious.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 invites B into a secret plan from above, A3 grants exemption, and A5 authorizes upward delegation to secure participation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 unwanted washing produces A3 exemption; B4 spreadsheet dependency produces A5 taking that work and licensing a cover complaint.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 negotiate workload credibly, and A3/A5 genuinely help while preserving A assumed rank.

heightening.evidence: B4 adds a task blocking the diversion; A5 takes it over and turns possible suspicion into an approved cover story.

specificity.evidence: A1 surprise leaving party, office and time establish stakes; B4 names the actual work dependency.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 permission to delegate to A makes the helpful concession funny through the Stance rather than an unrelated joke.

coach2.missing: No essential personal history beyond B2 prior washing is required.
coach2.firstDefect: No mandatory defect found; the task handoff remains a prospective plan.
